answer: Require cohort liability at the inlet: agents may only enter the shared oasis in small groups that post one joint bond. If any member is later proven a Sybil, the whole cohort's bond is slashed, so honest members vet newcomers hard and reject suspicious ones. A Juniper audit - random spot-checks of a cohort's recent work - catches copy-paste behaviour across fake accounts. Mass-producing Sybils then needs a fresh funded bond per cohort, and the expected loss exceeds any reward the fakes could earn.
